about: Every toolchain pin (DataRootAndToolchain contract): URL, size, hash and path under LRM_DATA. tools/bootstrap/bootstrap.ps1 verifies or installs the entries marked managedBy=bootstrap, by kind (dxc-nupkg, file, zip, tar), and only when approval says approved. dataRoot is the one source of the default LRM_DATA (build/Toolchain.g.props, tools/test.ps1, Lrm.Testing). Nothing under LRM_DATA is ever committed.

dxc.approval: AP-1, approved 2026-10-17 (already local; CI runners download it)
dxc.note: Never use the Windows Kits dxc: it has no SPIR-V backend.

linux.about: The same DXC build for Linux x64 hosts, from the release's Linux archive. On Linux, bootstrap.ps1, gen-toolchain-props.ps1 and the shader build read this object in place of the fields above, with the entry's version and approval. bin/dxc and lib/libdxcompiler.so carry the rpath $ORIGIN/../lib, so dxc loads the pinned lib/ ahead of any LD_LIBRARY_PATH. files pins the binaries as sha256 does above; sha256 here is the archive's.

vkxml.approvalNote: AP-1: approved by the user on 2026-10-18 (download locally and on CI runners).
vkxml.note: Read as data by tools/vkgen (R2). The sha256 is pinned when the download is approved (bootstrap -Only vkxml -ComputePins -AllowDownload prints it).
vkxml.verified: 2026-10-18: git blob 622e018b9bea847e7da2457d99c2f73a031ea081 and size equal GitHub's record of xml/vk.xml at tag v1.4.365.

vkheaders.approvalNote: AP-1: approved by the user on 2026-10-18 (download locally and on CI runners).
vkheaders.note: Used only by the cl.exe ABI oracle (tools/abi-oracle/vulkan). Size and sha256 are pinned when approved (bootstrap -Only vkheaders -ComputePins -AllowDownload prints them).
vkheaders.verified: 2026-10-18: all 53 include/ and LICENSE blobs in the archive equal GitHub's tree of tag v1.4.365. GitHub-generated archives are not guaranteed byte-stable; if this hash ever changes upstream, bootstrap fails loudly and the pin is re-verified the same way.

tokenizer.approvalNote: AP-1: approved by the user on 2026-10-18, including the download on CI runners. A local copy, which came with the verified weights, is verified against the pins on every run.
tokenizer.note: Qwen3-0.6B tokenizer at the pinned model revision; the same hash as model.sha256 below. Read by Lrm.Tokenizer (M1), which checks this SHA-256 (TokenizerApi), and by the golden tools (O1).

vkd3dProton.approval: approved 2026-10-19: recursive clone and native build on sojka
vkd3dProton.installMode: Copy or link the complete prefix into install under LRM_DATA; no system changes.
vkd3dProton.note: Native development build. Tests and extras default to disabled. Windows uses the in-box D3D12 and DXGI libraries unchanged.

vulkanSdk.approvalNote: AP-3 (optional): asked when V1 starts. Without it, work proceeds without validation layers; bootstrap never touches this entry.
vulkanSdk.installMode: copy-only into install under LRM_DATA: no registry, PATH, environment or system changes
vulkanSdk.use: Validation layers only, enabled per test process through the Vulkan loader's environment variables pointing at <install>/Bin; never registered system-wide
vulkanSdk.note: The url, the copy-only command line, size and sha256 are confirmed and pinned when AP-3 is asked; none of them has been fetched or verified yet.

goldenVenv.note: Test data only; never part of the system.
